Technomancy Ray.name: Technomancy Ray
Technomancy Ray.description:
You fire a ray of technologically empowered magic at your opponent. Make a spell attack roll with your innovation against a target within 30 feet. On a hit, the ray deals 1d4 fire damage or twice this amount and 1 persistent fire damage on a critical success. If you are a master in Crafting, the die size of your ray increases to d6, and if you are legendary in Crafting, the die size increases to d8.

If you have a Variable Core, you change the damage type from fire damage to the type you chose and replace the fire trait with that damage trait.
